messages:
Maya - Marketing: Heads up — prepping the international webinar (EMEA/APAC) next Tue. Need quick alignment on reg page A/B, Zoom topology, and post-event lead routing.
Raj - DevRel: I can handle the reg page A/B test. Plan: variant A uses benefit-first copy, variant B uses benchmark-led narrative + product demo CTA. Link to staging in a sec. :memo:
Sophie - Events: Can we set the event time at 10:00 BST / 18:00 SGT? That hits both EMEA and APAC reasonably. Also need speaker availability confirmed.
Jordan - Ops: Zoom plan: primary Zoom webinar, RTMP fallback to our backup stream (rtmp://backup.redwood). Recording to cloud + local backup on the host laptop. Will enable attendee Q&A.
Tara - Content: For the benchmark narrative, I want a 2-slide summary in the deck + 3 quote blurbs for the reg page. Also need three tweet-sized snippets for launch posts.
Maya - Marketing: Lead routing: all registrants -> HubSpot list "WA-Intl-2026". Attended -> tag "WA-Intl-2026-attended" and send replay nurture. Drop UTM params ?utm_source=twitter&utm_campaign=wa-intl for socials.
Raj - DevRel: Staging reg links: https://staging.redwood.com/reg/wa-intl-A and .../wa-intl-B. I'll attach GA event tracking, and a hidden field for consent checkbox state.
Sophie - Events: Captioning: CaptionBot, can we get live captions + post-event SRT? Also need 30-day replay TTL and SRT attached to replay asset.
CaptionBot: Live captions enabled. Post-event SRT will be exported to /assets/captions/2755554321/ and available after processing. :robot_face:
Jordan - Ops: Recording split: webinar recording -> cloud (full.mp4) and auto-generate clips at 1, 3, 7 mins markers. Ops will tag clips with timestamps for editors. Also transcode to 1080/720/480 for CDN.
Tara - Content: Ownership: Marketing owns the social clip edits; Product owns the feature deep-dive clip. I'll create a Clips ownership doc in Drive.
Maya - Marketing: On consent: please add a checkbox "I agree to be contacted" on reg page. No checkbox = registrant still goes to HS but marked no-contact and excluded from nurtures.
Raj - DevRel: Rehearsal: Fri 09:00 BST. Need all speakers + one producer. I'll set up test tokens for SSO auth and verify screen-sharing permissions.
Sophie - Events: Fallback host: @Jordan will be backup host in case the main host loses connection. Jordan ok?
Jordan - Ops: Yep I'll be standing by. I'll also enable co-host controls for producer and product PM.
Maya - Marketing: Postflow: within 1 hour send attended replay + 3 highlight clips to attendees. Non-attendees get full replay + top clip within 4 hours. Nurture sequence day+2 and day+7.
Raj - DevRel: Quick tech checklist I'll paste below:
```
- Enable cloud recording + local backup
- RTMP fallback configured
- Live captions on (CaptionBot)
- SSO for speakers + test tokens
- Breakout disabled (webinar mode)
- Q&A moderation enabled
- Transcode post-recording (1080/720/480)
- Export SRT and VTT
- Push registrants to HS list via Zapier flow
```
Sophie - Events: Zoom cohost list: Maya, Raj, Jordan, Producer. Producer will manage Q&A. Also confirm that the registration confirmation email includes calendar .ics (all locales).
Tara - Content: Localization: short 1-2 sentence translated blurb for JP and DE on the reg page hero. I can source translations Monday.
Maya - Marketing: Action items recap: Raj -> staging links + GA + consent field; Jordan -> Zoom topology + RTMP + rehearsal host; Sophie -> captions + calendar attachments + speaker confirmations; Tara -> deck blurbs + social snippets + translations. I'll own HubSpot routing and nurture templates.
ops-bot: Reminder scheduled — rehearsal Fri 09:00 BST. 2 reminders: 24h and 1h before.
Maya - Marketing: Thanks team. If we can verify the feed-to-CDN workflow in rehearsal (clip generation and HubSpot mapping) we'll be good. Ping here with any blockers. :rocket:
